zh: 昨天在超市里碰到了老朋友。
old_en: I ran into an old friend at the supermarket yesterday.
new_en: I ran into an old friend at the supermarket yesterday.

zh: 如果在路上遇到他，可以请他帮我带份报纸。
old_en: If I run into him on the street, I can ask him to bring me a newspaper.
new_en: If I run into him on the street, I can ask him to bring me a newspaper.

zh: 下次如果碰到她，建议跟她聊聊最近的工作。
old_en: Next time if I run into her, I suggest chatting with her about her recent work.
new_en: Next time I see her, I suggest chatting about her recent work.

zh: 因为搬家，我在新的小区里遇到了以前的邻居。
old_en: Because of moving, I ran into my previous neighbors in the new neighborhood.
new_en: I ran into my old neighbors in my new neighborhood because of moving.
